entry.title: The sewer pump station contract: Sewer Commission, 2026-09-08
entry.summary: Authorize development and advertising of a comprehensive procurement combining sewer pump station operations, maintenance, emergency services, and construction/capital repair work into a single multi-year contract, and recommend a warrant article authorizing the town to enter such a contract at the November 17, 2026 special town meeting. — passed (heard as "motion carries")
